exposure.needed: whether a Pod of a Kafka resource restarts at runtime and the Kubernetes events emitted during that restart are consumed by operators or tooling

consequence.statement: Kubernetes events emitted during a Pod restart now carry the Kafka resource as the regardingObject and the Pod in the related field, so consumers of these events see the changed object references; nothing in the evidence indicates a failure.
consequence.remediation: No action is required; verify that any tooling or dashboards consuming these Kubernetes events expects the Kafka resource in regardingObject and the Pod in related.

assertion.statement: Kubernetes events emitted during a Pod restart in Strimzi 0.46.0 now have the Kafka resource as the regardingObject and the Pod in the related field.
